captions: The buyers | who get these buildings | are rarely the ones | with the *most money.* They're the ones | who are [READY.] There are | [FOUR THINGS] | to have in place. First, | your [CRITERIA.] Write down | the areas | and the type of building, | your price range | and the minimum yield | you'd expect. If you can't say it | in [ONE SENTENCE,] | an agent | can't match you | to anything. Then there's | [FINANCE.] Have an agreement | in principle | or proof of funds | *before* you view, | not after | you offer. There's also | your [SOLICITOR.] Line up one | who does | commercial and | mixed-use work | before you find | the building. And then there's | [SPEED.] When the right building | comes up, | view it | within a few days | and decide | within a [WEEK.] Good buildings | don't wait | for *second viewings.*
